purpose: Mechanically preserve a finite owner outcome, version-fence work, authorize actions, invalidate stale proof, distinguish real automatic waiting, and block false completion.
invariants: One immutable contract hash per mission version.
Optional improvements cannot enter the frozen denominator.
A revision increments exactly once and cancels stale permits and wait jobs.
Only an EXECUTE decision can issue a single-use action-bound permit.
Denied, cancelled and stale actions never invoke an executor.
Effect replays are idempotent and payload changes under one key fail closed.
Proof remains valid only for its exact mission version, claim, dependencies, authority, environment and age.
WAITING_AUTOMATICALLY requires a durable job, checkpoint, non-user wake subscription, resume action and readback endpoint.
COMPLETE_VERIFIED requires every frozen requirement, terminal fruit and terminal authority route.
A malformed coordination record never means the resource is free.
Zero discovered or executed tests cannot certify success.
Deletion-only changes remain visible to proof selection.
